name: 2. Bus cancelled
description: Along a bus route. The bus the plan uses is cancelled at 02:12; live bus info reports it, and the plan moves to a later bus or another way (never the cancelled one). (Simulated night buses: no route here has real night hours. No Backup is expected: the only other ways are walks over the 4 km limit, and a 4 h wait for the first metro is not a way.)
